title: Advertising-truck contest with Rene's band
summary: Kelly's band and Rene's met on Roman Street and neither would move for three hours.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I heard you used a mute and was good on the blues. Oh, on that Floyd's thing. The rubber plunger. Yeah. Oh I used to like him playing Kelly's Love. Song My hat over my arm and lay behind it. He was a good street man. In them days used to have some advertising. You get out on the street with a truck, you better be right. Don't a guy run you all over town. I remember one Sunday, this must have been about 2 o'clock, our band and Randy met there on Roman Street. We stayed there from 2 until after 5.
Right there. One band wouldn't move. Chris told the fellow if we move in there you get out. You get out. So we finished our advertising right there.
Who won? Did anybody tell who they thought was best?

Was it? You crowd, you see. He beat. Some guy pulled for Chris. But Rene had to pull a good pull over there because he used to live there on Cornice Street. Yeah. That was only a couple of blocks from his house. Yeah, all his friends. Yeah. We had some friends around there too.
